# WanderCut

> WanderCut is a travel video editing service run by Zain ul Wara, a freelance video editor in Karachi, Pakistan. It edits Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, Facebook Reels, YouTube travel vlogs and Patreon content for travel creators and digital nomads.

Key facts:
- Upwork: Top Rated Plus, 97% Job Success Score, 150+ completed jobs
- 1000+ projects delivered
- Turnaround: 12-24 hours for short-form reels, 24-48 hours for YouTube vlogs
- 2 rounds of revisions included in every package
- Software: DaVinci Resolve 19, After Effects, Adobe Audition
- Works with raw LOG and flat footage (Sony S-Log, Canon C-Log, GoPro Protune, DJI D-Log)
- Pricing is quoted per project after a free 15-minute discovery call

## Services
- [Travel Vlog Editing](https://wandercut.github.io/#services): full-length YouTube vlogs with colour grading, music sync, captions and retention-focused pacing
- [Short-Form Reels](https://wandercut.github.io/#services): 9:16 vertical edits for Instagram, TikTok and Facebook with hooks, trending audio and text overlays
- [Daily Content Package](https://wandercut.github.io/#services): retainer editing for creators who post every day
- [Patreon Exclusives](https://wandercut.github.io/#services): behind-the-scenes edits and extended cuts for Patreon communities
- [Brand Style Kit](https://wandercut.github.io/#services): intro/outro animations, lower thirds, LUT packs and text templates
- [Captions & Subtitles](https://wandercut.github.io/#services): animated captions and multi-language SRT files

## Learn more
- [How it works](https://wandercut.github.io/#hiw): send footage, receive a preview within 24 hours, publish after up to 2 revisions

- [FAQ](https://wandercut.github.io/#faq): turnaround, pricing, software, revisions, retainers and footage formats
